description: Permanently delete a template authoring draft by draftId. Call only when abandoning a draft that should be permanently destroyed. If the draft is complete and ready for production, call publish_template_draft instead. Destructive operation requiring explicit user confirmation: draft canvas data, layer AST, and unpublished revisions cannot be recovered. Returns deletion confirmation record.

draftId.description: The unique draft identifier to permanently delete.

name: delete_template_draft
title: Delete authoring draft
